Actually buy low now, sell next rounds... next round cash devalues 38%, so converting cash to goods is good. Buy 4? Leaves almost no cash for action (donkey needs 1 alashi, bribe). Round 4 action has auction; need cash to bid. License income 20-60 alashi; bid is important. Keep cash for auction.

Buy 3 for 21 alashi leaves 11.4 for auction. Prices: I buy at counter 3 price index 8-2=6 each? Cash shows 21 spent for 3 units → 7 per unit. Future market round 5: prices shift reset? price_shift -2 applied to this market only. Round 5 prices: counter back at 0 after buying 3 → price 12. Selling 3 then at 12 = 36 alashi... but everyone produces. Likely good: buy 3, sell at 12 next round. Strong choice.
